reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for read-only inspection of Git repository state, changes, history, references, conflicts, blame, stashes, and worktrees.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读 Git 检查工具，用于查看仓库状态、差异、历史、引用、冲突、归属、stash 和 worktree 信息。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with read-only Git inspection tools for repository status, diffs, history, references, conflicts, blame, stashes, and worktrees.

capabilities: Reads local Git repository status, diffs, history, references, conflicts, blame, stashes, and worktrees
Invokes read-only Git inspection commands through a subprocess service
Returns bounded command output and structured errors
